## From the workbench

A **Markdown reader** for notes on code and security. Write naturally with *emphasis*, ~~old ideas~~, and `inline code`.

> [!NOTE]
> Useful information to keep in mind while reading.

> [!HEADS UP]
> Something that deserves a closer look before you continue.

> [!CONTEXT]
> Background that explains the decisions behind the work.

> [!QUOTE]
> “The best way to learn is to build something, then understand why it works.”

> [!DISCLAIMER]
> These notes reflect my own experience and are for **educational purposes**, not professional advice.

### A small checklist

- [x] Keep the terminal text-first
- [x] Match your Catppuccin theme
- [ ] Write the next post

### Code, without surprises

```js
const greeting = 'Hello, reader.';
console.log(greeting);
```

| Syntax | Result |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Bold** and *italic* | Emphasis |
| [A project link](https://github.com/adamgdegr/adamgdegr) | An actionable link |
| `<script>` | Text, never executable HTML |

> Ordinary blockquotes work too, including **formatted text**.
